rules: All question/reply reads and all writes require the discovery token and existing local-origin boundaries
Heartbeat question and acceptsReplies fields require awaitingHuman true and state waiting; acceptsReplies defaults false
Public inventory and SSE expose no question or answer body; private reply memory is bounded and never persisted
Observed local transcript questions remain copy delivery; process presence never creates a question or reply channel
Answer submission returns queued; explicit matching adapter acknowledgement returns acknowledged; neither clears waiting
Only subsequent provider activity/heartbeat resolves the waiting employee; new/expired questions reject stale replies
One answer per current question; identical submissions are idempotent and conflicting answers return 409
The app never injects keystrokes, edits provider logs, invokes Claude, or spawns a replacement session to claim delivery
